Pol najčešće utiče na proporcije sata, š: Gender often influences watch proportions, case size, strap length and the overall balance on your wrist. Men's watches are usually larger and bolder; women's models are often slimmer and more elegant. Unisex models offer neutral proportions without strict rules.
Ako biraš poklon ili nisi siguran koliko: If you are choosing a gift or are unsure how prominent the watch should look, unisex models are often a good starting point, with proportions suited to both classic and contemporary styles.
Stil je najbrži način da suziš izbor jer: Style helps narrow your choice: everyday wear, the office, an active lifestyle or a statement piece. It influences the case shape, dial contrast, additional functions and how formal or relaxed the watch looks.
Ako sat treba da radi u više situacija t: For a watch that works in several settings, start with casual or minimal/retro styles. Dress watches offer a clean, polished look, while sports and outdoor watches prioritise durability, readability and a robust feel.
Budžet ne menja samo cenu, već i nivo za: Your budget influences the finish, materials, feel on your wrist and choice of features. Lower price ranges focus on practical, reliable watches; higher budgets often offer more refined cases, detailed dials and premium bracelets.
Ako tražiš najbolji odnos uloženog i dob: The middle price range often offers good value. For a more luxurious feel or a special gift, consider a slightly higher budget if it suits you.
Svaki brend nosi drugačiji dizajnerski p: Every brand has its own design identity. Some are known for functionality and durability, others for elegance or everyday value. Choosing a brand helps you find watches that look and work the way you want.
Ako već znaš da ti se dopada određeni ka: If you already like a particular brand, selecting it can narrow the catalogue quickly. If you are still exploring, choose “No preference” and let your style and budget guide you first.
Prečnik govori koliko će sat biti prisut: The diameter determines how prominent a watch looks on your wrist. Smaller watches tend to feel more discreet and elegant; medium sizes are versatile, while larger cases create a bolder, sportier impression.
Ako ne znaš odakle da kreneš, 36–40mm je: If you are unsure, 36–40 mm is a useful starting point for many wrists and styles. Larger diameters create a bolder look but can feel oversized on a smaller wrist.
Narukvica ili kaiš u velikoj meri određu: The bracelet or strap shapes the look and comfort of a watch. Steel is durable and polished, leather is classic and elegant, silicone suits an active lifestyle, and fabric or mesh offers a more relaxed or distinctive style.
Ako ti je važna svakodnevna praktičnost: Steel and silicone are practical choices for everyday use and easy care. Leather and mesh can add character even to a simple watch.
